search.label: Search the site
manifesto.text: Basira is short games that entertain and teach. Every question has a source, and every round runs on your device with no sign-up. Play for five minutes and leave with a fact worth retelling.
hero.title: Play smart. Know more.
hero.lede: Ten brain games and a fresh challenge every day, with sourced questions. Start instantly with no sign-up; your results stay on your device.
games.title: Pick your challenge
topics.title: Explore knowledge
latest.title: Read, then test yourself
verify.title: How we verify
verify.text: Every figure and date in our articles has a cited source, and game questions are reviewed before they appear, never generated while you play.
foot.note: Sourced knowledge and brain games, no sign-up needed.
lang.note: English questions and articles are still under review, so questions are shown in Arabic for now.
noscript: Games and the daily challenge need JavaScript enabled in your browser.
g.mcq.name: Test your knowledge
g.mcq.desc: Four answers, one correct, with an explanation after each
g.truefalse.name: True or false?
g.truefalse.desc: Judge fast before time runs out
g.order.name: Order the timeline
g.order.desc: Drag events into the right place
g.memory.name: Memory twins
g.memory.desc: Find the pairs in as few moves as you can
g.word.name: Crack the code
g.word.desc: A hidden word and hints to save you
g.result.pass: Well done! You passed the round
g.local: Your results are saved on this device only.
g.rules.mcq: Answer multiple-choice questions before time runs out. Fast, consecutive answers earn more points, and you can remove two answers once per round.
g.rules.truefalse: Judge each statement true or false, quickly. Each consecutive correct answer raises your streak multiplier.
g.rules.order: Put the events in order from earliest to latest by drag and drop or the up and down buttons, then press Check. You get a point for each event in its right place.
g.rules.memory: Flip two cards to find matching pairs in as few moves as possible. Higher levels have more cards.
g.rules.word: Guess the hidden word from its hint. You have three attempts, and you can reveal a letter for two points.
daily.title: Today's challenge
daily.sub: The same five questions for every player today. Can you beat your friends? Challenge XP counts once a day.
profile.title: Your journey
profile.none: You haven't played yet. Start any game and your journey will show up here.
profile.reset: Clear my data on this device
profile.confirm: This will erase all your progress on this device. Sure?
ach.daily3.d: Finish the daily challenge on 3 different days
ach.hard.d: Pass a hard round with 70% or more
challenge.title: Friend challenge
challenge.invite: Your friend challenges you on {date} with {s} points. Play the same questions and compare your result.
challenge.share.text: I challenge you on BASIRA! My score: {score} points. Play the same challenge: {url}
challenge.copy.prompt: Copy and share this challenge link
pstrip.new: Play a round to earn XP
cta.title: Done reading? Test yourself
cta.sub: Five games with reviewed questions and a daily challenge; your progress stays on your device
empty.title: Nothing here
empty.sub: The page does not exist or no results match. Try searching or start a game.
g.math.name: Quick math
g.pattern.name: What comes next?
g.pattern.desc: Spot the rule and complete the pattern
g.simon.name: Follow the pattern
g.simon.desc: Watch the sequence, then repeat it from memory
g.blitz.name: One-minute blitz
g.blitz.desc: How many can you answer in 60 seconds?
g.survival.name: Survival
g.survival.desc: Only three lives. Every mistake costs one
g.rules.math: Work out the result in your head and pick the right answer before time runs out. Fast, consecutive answers earn more points. Every problem is computed by the program, so the answers are always right.
g.rules.pattern: Every row of numbers hides a rule: a constant step, doubling, squares or a sum of two terms. Spot it and pick the next number; the rule is explained after each question.
g.rules.simon: Watch the buttons light up in order, then repeat the same order. The sequence grows each round and the game ends at your first mistake.
g.rules.blitz: You have 60 seconds to answer as many questions as you can. No waiting between questions, and a streak boosts your points. Reaching the target means you pass.
g.rules.survival: Only three lives. Each wrong answer costs one life and the round ends when they are gone. Answer the target number to pass.
pattern.q: What is the next number in the pattern?
pattern.why.arith: The step between numbers is constant: {d}.
pattern.why.geo: Each number is the previous one times {r}.
pattern.why.sq: These are consecutive square numbers (a number times itself).
pattern.why.fib: Each number is the sum of the two before it.
pattern.why.diff: The gaps grow by the same amount at every step.
pattern.why.tri: Triangular numbers: add 2, then 3, then 4 and so on.
simon.next: Nice, a harder round is coming
habit.goal.done: Goal done and chest opened. Come back tomorrow to keep the streak.
habit.safe: Your streak is safe today. Finish three rounds to open the reward chest.
habit.risk: Play one round today to keep your streak.
habit.first: Play a round today to start a daily streak.
habit.next: In {n} days you reach {d} days and earn {x} XP
habit.sync: Move your progress to another device
habit.sync.text: No account or email: copy the code here, paste it on the other device and press Import. Importing replaces the progress on that device.
g.bubbles.name: Knowledge bubbles
g.bubbles.desc: Tap the right bubble before it floats away
g.rules.bubbles: Four bubbles float up, each holding a possible answer. Tap the right one to pop it. Each question is timed, and all questions are reviewed and stored on your device.
sch.ask: Tap the numbers from 1 to {n} in order
g.stroop.name: Tricky colors
g.stroop.desc: Tap the ink color, not the word
g.rules.stroop: A color word appears written in a different color. Tap the name of the ink color, not what the word says. Time is short, and higher levels add more choices.
g.compare.name: Which is bigger
g.compare.desc: Compare two sums and pick the bigger before time runs out
g.rules.compare: Two sums appear. Tap the one with the bigger result before time runs out. Every result is computed by the program.
g.count.name: Quick count
g.count.desc: Dots flash for a moment, then vanish. How many were there?
g.rules.count: Colored dots show for a few seconds and disappear. Pick the correct count from four options.
g.schulte.name: Number chase
g.schulte.desc: Tap the numbers in order from 1 as fast as you can
g.rules.schulte: A scattered board of numbers. Tap them in order from 1 to the last before time runs out. A wrong tap does not count and costs time.
g.odd.name: Spot the odd one
g.odd.desc: One square is a slightly different shade. Find it
g.rules.odd: A grid of similar squares where one differs in shade. Tap the odd one. Higher levels enlarge the grid and shrink the difference.
g.multiples.name: Multiples hunt
g.multiples.desc: Tap every multiple of the target number and nothing else
g.rules.multiples: You get a number. Tap all of its multiples in the grid. One wrong tap ends the question.
g.digits.name: Digit memory
g.digits.desc: Memorize the digits, then type them back
g.rules.digits: Digits show for two seconds and vanish. Type them back from memory on the keypad. Later questions add a digit.
gc.title: A friend challenged you
gc.invite: Your friend challenged you in "{g}" with {s} points on {l}. You will play the same questions in the same order, so the comparison is fair.
gc.share.text: I scored {score} in "{g}" on Basira. Can you beat me? {url}
stk.hint: Tap at the right moment to drop the block
rhy.hint: Tap when the circle touches the ring
g.stack.name: Tower balance
g.stack.desc: Build a tower by dropping blocks at the right moment
g.rules.stack: A block slides left and right above the tower. Tap (or press Space) to drop it. Any overhang is cut off, so the tower narrows. A perfectly aligned drop keeps its width and earns bonus points. Reach 15 floors.
g.rhythm.name: Ring rhythm
g.rhythm.desc: Tap the instant the circle meets the ring
g.rules.rhythm: A big circle shrinks toward a ring. Tap the exact moment it touches the ring. 16 beats, and consecutive hits raise your points.
g.merge.name: Merge numbers
g.merge.desc: Swipe to merge equal numbers up to the goal tile
g.rules.merge: Slide the tiles in any direction; two equal tiles that meet merge into their double. Reach the goal tile before the board fills. Swipe, use arrow keys, or the buttons.
int.ask: All are multiples of {k} except one. Find it
g.opsign.name: Missing sign
g.opsign.desc: Pick the missing operator between two numbers
g.rules.opsign: Two numbers and a result appear with a missing operator. Pick the operation (+ − × ÷) that makes the equation true. Each question has exactly one correct sign.
g.numline.name: Where is the number
g.numline.desc: Tap where the number sits on the number line
g.rules.numline: You get a number; tap where it sits on a line from zero to the maximum. Close enough counts, and higher levels shrink the margin.
g.pathmem.name: Path memory
g.pathmem.desc: Watch the lit path, then tap the cells in order
g.rules.pathmem: Cells light up in a sequence. Watch, then tap the same cells in the same order. The path grows longer as you go.
g.revdigits.name: Reverse memory
g.revdigits.desc: Memorize the digits, then type them in reverse
g.rules.revdigits: Digits show for two seconds and vanish. Type them in reverse, last digit first. Harder than plain digit memory.
g.shades.name: Dark to light
g.shades.desc: Tap the shades from darkest to lightest
g.rules.shades: A set of squares in different shades of one color. Tap the darkest first, then lighter step by step. One wrong tap ends the question.
g.intruder.name: Number intruder
g.intruder.desc: All numbers are multiples of one number except an intruder
g.rules.intruder: Every number in the grid is a multiple of a given number except one intruder. Tap it fast.
g.lantern.name: Basira's lantern
g.lantern.desc: Carry the lantern through a dark cave and catch the firefly that holds the right answer
g.rules.lantern: You are the owl and your lantern is your life. Drag your finger or use the arrow keys to fly. Answers are fireflies you can only read inside your light. The right one refuels the lantern and scares the bats away; a wrong one or a bat bite drains it and shrinks your light. Ten reviewed questions per round.
ltn.aria: Dark cave: move the owl to catch the right firefly
ltn.hint: Drag with your finger or use the arrow keys. Answers can only be read inside the light.
g.swarm.name: Light swarm
g.swarm.desc: Lead a swarm of fireflies past thorns and bats to the jar
g.rules.swarm: Your lantern pulls a swarm of fireflies. Drag it along the winding path. Thorns and bats kill fireflies, and the ones that reach the jar at the top are saved. Save enough in each of five stages to move on. No questions, just skill.
g.flip.name: Gravity owl
g.flip.desc: Flip gravity between floor and ceiling, dodge spikes and collect stars
g.rules.flip: The owl runs on its own and gets faster. Tap the screen or press space to flip gravity between floor and ceiling. Spikes end the run. Collect stars and go as far as you can.
g.mirrors.name: Light mirrors
g.mirrors.desc: Turn the mirrors until the lantern beam hits every crystal
g.rules.mirrors: A beam leaves the lantern on the left. Tap a mirror to flip it between / and \\. Light every crystal. Each of the five levels has a known best number of moves, and fewer moves earn more stars.
sw.aria: Light swarm: drag the lantern to lead fireflies to the jar
sw.hint: Drag the lantern and the swarm follows. Follow the glowing path and avoid thorns and bats up to the jar.
fl.aria: Gravity owl: tap to flip gravity
fl.hint: Tap the screen or press space to flip gravity between floor and ceiling.
mr.hint: Tap a mirror to flip it between / and \. The beam starts at the yellow lantern on the left.
mr.m1: Mirror leaning right, tap to flip
mr.m2: Mirror leaning left, tap to flip
